kyoto_osteria_bastille.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta, bread and breaded dishes sit beside steak, game, carpaccio and salads; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_osteria_bastille.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and the official site stresses organic vegetables from Kyoto and Shiga growers, but most dishes are meat or fish (Tabelog; official site; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_osteria_bastille.hours_raw: Thu and Sun 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:00); Fri, Sat and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Mon–Wed for dining, with catering and large take-away orders (Tabelog; official site, January 2025). Bookings advised — "Reservations are necessary" (October 2025 review); lunch courses can be booked, other lunches by phone from 10:00 (February 2026 review). Service charge: none — Tabelog's Japanese original says "なし"; a ¥440 seat-and-bread charge applies to table-only bookings (Tabelog). Lunch is cash only; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) and PayPay at dinner (Tabelog). 22 seats, about five tables (March 2022 review); children welcome; non-smoking (Tabelog). 5 min from Shijo or Karasuma Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_osteria_bastille.notes: [Italian-French bistro · near Shijo-Karasuma] A cosy, antique-filled osteria of about 22 years, mixing Italian and French: carpaccio, sakura-shrimp pasta, game such as venison braised in red wine, and generous lunch sets around ¥1,800–2,900. Lunch Thu–Sun, dinner Fri–Sat only; book ahead, and bring cash for lunch.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the chef draws on training abroad to take "the best of French and Italian"; the name comes from the Bastille quarter of Paris; the 22nd anniversary was marked in December 2025; in recent years the shop has added catering, markets and outdoor events. A long-time regular describes it as "run by a lovely couple" (August 2025 review), while the official site advertises for part-time staff.
chef_bio.philosophy: A "上質な日常" (a fine everyday) in a European room of antique furniture; safe food with clear origins, buying organic vegetables directly from Kyoto and Shiga growers (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Italian-French bistro dishes; game in season.

anecdotes.text: A diner of nearly 20 years called it a warm restaurant whose gentle flavours reflect the owners' kind personalities — August 2025.
In October 2025 a couple had the season's first venison, from Shiga, and found it remarkably tender.
Calling on a snowy February 2026 morning, two friends got a same-day table and said the meal "blew our taste buds away".
A September 2026 pair noted the pasta came split onto two plates unasked.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: オステリア バスティーユ、中京区烏丸蛸薬師東入ル一蓮社町310 メゾン高見1F、シェフ 山本 知 (SATORU YAMAMOTO)、海外での修行を生かしたフレンチとイタリアンのいいとこ取り、京都・滋賀の生産者から仕入れる有機野菜、アンティーク家具の空間、ケータリング・ランチボックス・ネットショップ、月火水休み (ケータリング対応)・木日ランチのみ・金土ランチとディナー (2025年1月)、2025年12月に22周年、アルバイト募集中。食べログ (店舗会員): イタリアン・フレンチ・ダイニングバー、22席、サービス料なし、席のみ予約は席料・パン代440円、ランチは現金のみ。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年9月、英語): 夫婦で営む温かい店、前菜盛り合わせ、カルパッチョ、桜海老のパスタ、砂肝とベーコンのサラダ、鹿肉、日替わり1,800円、パスタセット2,900円、予約推奨。

cultural_comfort.note: Small bistro; book ahead; cash only at lunch.

existence.note: Tabelog listing kept by the shop and the official site (news dated April 2026); reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_griddle_force_itsuraku.gf_detail: Ask. Teppan steak with sauces, a curry to finish, croquettes and fried sets at lunch; no gluten information (Tabelog; official site; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_griddle_force_itsuraku.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a teppanyaki steak restaurant (Tabelog).
kyoto_griddle_force_itsuraku.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30; lunch ends when sold out) and 18:00–22:00 (last orders food 21:00, drinks 21:30); closed Monday (Tabelog). The official site gives dinner as 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:00). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「席のみ予約のお客様には、お通し代として、500円頂いております。」 — a ¥500 appetizer charge for seat-only bookings. Lunch is cash only (August 2025 and October 2026 reviews); cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay, Rakuten Pay, au PAY per Tabelog. 16 seats: 10 at the counter and a hidden private room for six reached by a side passage and an intercom at the back door (Tabelog; official site gives 12 + 6). Children at lunch; at dinner only in the private room (Tabelog). Free Wi-Fi; non-smoking. 5 min from Karasuma or Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_griddle_force_itsuraku.notes: [Teppanyaki steak · near Shijo-Karasuma] A ten-seat teppan counter with a secret private room behind, where the chef grills Kyoto beef in front of you and finishes with a small curry instead of garlic rice. The lunch steak set (about ¥1,400, cash only) is the draw; dinner courses with lobster and wagyu run ¥8,000–10,000. Closed Monday.

roles: Manager (店長), maker of the finishing curry
chef_bio.background: Opened 19 November 2015 (Tabelog). The official site also links a sister izakaya, 居酒屋いつらく (kushiyaki).
chef_bio.philosophy: Kyoto beef fillet and sirloin, the day's best from a trusted Kyoto supplier, paired with wine (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Teppan steak; 吉田's mini curry to finish.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 lunch guest watched the chef grill lean beef on the teppan and cut it into bite-size pieces, at about ¥1,200.
A May 2026 diner loved the course and the private room but wished the staff were friendlier and the coffee deeper.
An October 2026 lunch guest was told to move to the end seat after choosing a seat, and that cards were not taken at lunch.
In October 2026 a guest left food and drinks to the chef and staff for a reunion dinner ending in the house curry.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: GRIDDLE FORCE.逸楽、中京区一連社町298-2 染匠会館1F、京都牛のフィレとサーロイン、店長の吉田が作る〆のミニカレー、グラスワイン赤白各3種・ボトル20種以上、店内奥の完全個室 (6名、裏口のインターフォンから)、ランチ 11:30〜14:00、ディナー 17:30〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、月曜休み、18席、姉妹店の居酒屋いつらく。食べログ (店舗会員): 鉄板焼き・ステーキ、2015年11月19日オープン、火〜日 11:30〜14:00・18:00〜22:00、16席、席のみ予約はお通し代500円、金目鯛のカルパッチョ、仔羊フィレ。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年10月、英語): ステーキランチ大中小、中225g 1,400円、ランチは現金のみ、ロブスターと和牛のコース。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter seating; cash only at lunch.

existence.note: Tabelog listing kept by the shop and the official site; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_goko_machi_sasaki.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a tempura izakaya; the batter is wheat. Sashimi and simmered dishes exist, but fryer and broth are shared (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_goko_machi_sasaki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish and meat dishes; vegetable tempura is served with dashi-based broth (2026 reviews).
kyoto_goko_machi_sasaki.hours_raw: 15:00–22:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Bookings taken online; parties of five or more by phone. "If you are unable to order from the Japanese menu, we will accommodate you with a course menu" (Tabelog). 16 seats: 8 at the counter, 8 at tables; children and strollers welcome; non-smoking, smoking area outside; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). On Goko Machi Street, in the former home of Umaimonya Issho (February 2026 review); 7 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_goko_machi_sasaki.notes: [Tempura izakaya · Goko Machi Street near Kyoto City Hall] A calm counter-and-table izakaya, opened 2024, frying Edo-style tempura in sesame oil to order — clams in the shell with broth, Kamo eggplant, lotus root — alongside sashimi, duck roast and good sake. Opens at 15:00 for an early drink; about ¥6,000–8,000. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 27 June 2024 (Tabelog), in the former home of Umaimonya Issho (February 2026 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Edo-style tempura in sesame oil that brings out the ingredients, with seasonal dishes from the morning market (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 diner found some drinks and dishes unavailable and the busy owner a bit unfriendly.
An August 2026 guest arriving at 16:30 was first in, followed by two older local couples; the ayu simmered with sansho sold out as the couples ordered it.
In October 2026 the master cooked alone; a pair ordered the clam tempura twice, and a staff member who came in later served a foreign family in fluent English.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 御幸町ささき、居酒屋・天ぷら、中京区御幸町通押小路上る山本町427、京都市役所前駅から徒歩7分、15:00〜22:00、水曜休み、2024年6月27日オープン、16席 (カウンター8・テーブル8)、子供可、禁煙 (店外に喫煙所)、カード可、関西では珍しい胡麻油の江戸前天ぷら、市場の旬の一品、刺身、おばんざい、日本酒15〜20種、日本語の品書きで注文できない方にはコースで対応。口コミ (2026年2〜10月、英語): 牡蠣の Tamayose 770円、鴨ロース1,100円、ぶりのレアカツ1,540円、蛤の天ぷら、なす、唐辛子、海老とセロリの春巻き、焼売、店主が一人で揚げる、英語の堪能なスタッフ、店主が忙しく無愛想という声。

cultural_comfort.note: Japanese menu; a course is offered to guests who cannot order from it (Tabelog); an English-speaking staff member was seen in October 2026.

existence.note: Tabelog listing kept by the shop; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_sake_dokoro_shikata.gf_detail: Ask. Dote-ni and oden in soy-based broth, sashimi, clay-pot rice; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sake_dokoro_shikata.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef-tendon dote-ni, fish and dashi dishes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sake_dokoro_shikata.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 daily; hours may change, check before visiting (Tabelog). Hitosara gives 17:00–24:00 with irregular holidays. Bookings taken (Tabelog). Counter on the ground floor, tables upstairs with a dumbwaiter by the stairs (August and November 2026 reviews); children welcome; non-smoking; cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). In a traditional Kyoto machiya (October 2026 review); about 300 m from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog; October 2026 review).
kyoto_sake_dokoro_shikata.notes: [Machiya izakaya · near Karasuma Oike] A stylish townhouse izakaya, counter downstairs and tables up: the signature dote-ni, oden, seasonal small plates and a clay-pot rice whose leftovers come back as onigiri to take away. About ¥3,000–5,000 with drinks; portions suit two, and staff offer solo-size helpings. Daily from 17:00.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe friendly, attentive staff in a traditional Kyoto machiya, popular with a younger crowd (2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 first-timer was told up front that portions serve about two, which helped with ordering.
An October 2026 diner was disappointed by the lack of Japanese sake on the menu, while an October 2026 traveller praised the drinks list.
A November 2026 party found the ikura dishes sold out and the dumbwaiter beside the upstairs table noisy, but loved the dote and oden.
A salt-averse October 2026 diner found the oden and doteyaki strong in soy but delicious.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 酒処 四方、居酒屋、中京区烏帽子屋町477、烏丸御池駅から302m、毎日17:00〜23:00 (変更あり)、予約可、禁煙、子供可、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可。ヒトサラ: 17:00〜24:00、不定休。口コミ (2026年6〜11月、英語): 町家の居酒屋、1階カウンターと2階テーブル、名物の土手煮 (土手煮丼)、おでん、もつ煮、ねぎとろ、ポテサラとしめ鯖、鶏ももたたき、無花果の白ごまの和え物、土鍋ご飯の残りはおにぎりにして持ち帰り可、2人前ほどの量でおひとり様向けの量にも、日本酒がないという声と飲み物の品揃えを褒める声、2階の運搬機の音。四方食店 (姥柳町) との関係を示す資料は見つからなかった。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff offer solo-size portions; book ahead at weekends.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.
